<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CustomPrint"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/custom-3d-print">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_CustomPrint" name="Instruct an artist to create a 3D model and print it on a 3D printer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Craving" name="Craving a custom 3D model">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InstructArtist" name="Instruct artist to create project">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send several sketches to artist">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Review_Join" name="Review round join">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChangesLoop</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewResult" name="Review project result">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with result?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Satisfied</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotSatisfied</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestChanges" name="Tell artist what to change">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotSatisfied</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChangesLoop</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Satisfied</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InStock" name="Color in stock at home?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InStock</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotInStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRemaining" name="Check how much color is left">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100" name="Less than 100 g left?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Under100</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotUnder100</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddShoppingList" name="Add plastic to shopping list">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Under100</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderPlastic" name="Order plastic">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotInStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Plastic_Join" name="Plastic handled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotUnder100</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Split" name="Prepare printing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TurnOnPrinter" name="Turn on printer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatUp" name="Heat up bed and extruder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate gcode file from STL">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Join" name="Printer ready and gcode generated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Printed" name="Model printed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Craving" targetRef="Task_InstructArtist"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Review_Join" targetRef="Task_ReviewResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ReviewResult" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Satisfied" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${satisfied == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotSatisfied" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_RequestChanges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${satisfied == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChangesLoop" sourceRef="Task_RequestChanges" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_InStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock" targetRef="Task_CheckRemaining">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${colorInStock == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInStock" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock" targetRef="Task_OrderPlastic">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${colorInStock == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_CheckRemaining" targetRef="Gateway_Under100"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Under100" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Task_AddShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${remainingGrams < 100}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotUnder100" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Gateway_Plastic_Join">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${remainingGrams >= 100}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_AddShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_Plastic_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_OrderPlastic" targetRef="Gateway_Plastic_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_Plastic_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter" targetRef="Task_HeatUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_HeatUp" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Join" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="End_Printed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
